horizons.label: Latest before kickoff — not captured yet

limitations: Latest pregame is a separate benchmark; no N034 capture is available yet.
T2/T1 snapshots use last genuinely observed prices at or before each cutoff; exact-minute equality is not required. Quote age and timestamp skew are disclosed.
2024/2025 are development-exposed retrospective evaluations. 2026 leaders are descriptive monitoring, not ex-ante strategy selection.
Historical acquisition may occur after games; historical market timestamp is distinct from original possession.
N034 source normalization selected prior N033 DraftKings quotes despite new paid calls. Display clocks show the consumed snapshot.
Kalshi/Polymarket expected payout is a zero-tie probability proxy; half-tie settlement and fixed tie-rate sensitivities are preserved.
Threshold contracts do not supply margin or total regression point forecasts.
A game appearing in the schedule does not imply a historical model forecast or provider quote exists.
Original saved N012 rows lack row-level cutoff proof in the compact source; their horizon is unverified and they are excluded from T1/T2 primary pairs.
Model score centers combine independent margin/total heads; they are not calibrated exact-score probabilities.
Current books and early research issues are displayable. No executable positive-EV or current-fee profit claim is supported.
